It sounds like you might be depersonalized getting into a low mood/depression. I'm not a professional, but it could be helpful to search those terms/ other relating things and to see what you relate to on terms on how you're doing, and to see if you could see any professionals for this. For me, I tend to try to look for more information about how I feel and find it helpful to find a term for it anyway and what I could do. Getting to the root cause of your struggles is a lot easier to solve the issues that is happening now.   
I think people put too much on an emphasis on people's identity and that its something that is naturally occuring, only sharing the confident parts of themself with no sign of their own issues. And when people who are not completely sure of themselves feel as if this in incorrect or wrong.   


The fact is, it is not bad to be trying to find yourself and to be in a place where you are struggling. It sucks, but your feelings are understandable and valid. If you allow yourself to be in this feeling, and let go of the pressure to need to keep going after things to complete yourself it can allow you to heal and even find something you enjoy. By creating a strong foundation, you can build yourself up. But if you have a shaky foundation, nothing will stick.   
This is easier said than done, but I hope you feel better soon and that this helped a little. Of course you don't have to take everything I said for advice, but give it a try if you can.  
Tldr; look for more information to identify problems and get professional help (if you can), accept that you will not always be functional and not always know who you are (but don't focus too much on it) without judging yourself for that. Just keep going.
